reasons: Correctly classified as a deviation: a one-month 'Fees actually paid' cap is far below the fallback floor of 12 months' fees (and below the 6-month walk-away line), and 'without exception' pulls indemnities, confidentiality/data-protection and gross negligence/wilful misconduct inside the cap — expressly walk-away territory.

Redline reaches the preferred position with a targeted single-sentence replacement: mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, and removal of 'without exception' in favour of the Excluded Claims carve-out already defined in Section 21.3, so no duplicate carve-out list is introduced.

Definition check supports the finding: 'Fees' captures recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees (not an illusory set-up charge), so a 12-month basis is meaningful against the committed spend.

Failed 'minimal edit' heuristic (ratio 0.737) is acceptable here — the cap basis, mutual application and carve-out treatment all had to change, and the edit is confined to p0082 without rewriting Sections 21.2–21.4.

Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, states the playbook position and correctly notes that indemnities/confidentiality sit outside the cap; it does not misdescribe the surrounding sections.
